bluetooth_confirm.title: AFU Body Scale discovered
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found scale {name} ({address}). After adding it, your first weigh-in raises a card to create a user.

user.title: AFU Body Scale
user.description: Enter the scale's MAC address. User details are filled in at the first weigh-in.

new_user_menu.title: New user?
new_user_menu.description: A weigh-in of {weight} kg (impedance {impedance} Ω) did not match any existing user. What should happen? If it is a guest, choose Ignore.

new_user.title: New user

assign_existing.description: Assign this {weight} kg (impedance {impedance} Ω) to them and **discard their previous reference weight**. Use it when their weight changed a lot or they have not weighed in for a long time.

add_user.title: Add user
add_user.description: A reading within a person's reference weight range is treated as theirs.

data_description.height_cm: Used for body-fat and other BIA calculations
data_description.initial_weight: If set, this person is recognised from the very first weigh-in; otherwise their first weigh-in raises a card so you can assign it to them
data_description.tolerance_kg: A reading counts as theirs if it is within ± this of their reference weight; auto (max(2kg, 3%), widening over time) if empty

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Enables the afu_scale.inject_packet service, which feeds a raw packet in as if the scale sent it. For testing when the scale can't connect.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description:
Seconds unless noted. The integration reloads on save.
Quiet time: the longest time after an idle connection that the scale is left alone so it can sleep; 0 disables it (more empty connections, but no missed weigh-ins).

data.reset_delta_kg: Weight change that means another person (kg)

assign_last_measurement.name: Assign last measurement
assign_last_measurement.description: Reassign the latest measurement to a user (e.g. it was taken as a guest or attributed to the wrong person) and undo the previous attribution.

inject_packet.name: Inject packet (debug)
inject_packet.description: Process a raw 20-byte packet as if the scale sent it. Requires debug to be enabled in the integration options.
